Hazelchat.PluginDescription: Add the Hazelchat AI chat agent with Tag Manager and see chats and enquiries in Matomo, with a ready goal.
Hazelchat.TagDescription: Adds your Hazelchat AI chat agent to your website.
Hazelchat.TagHelp: Use the Pageview trigger. The chat appears once your agent is live for this website in Hazelchat.
Hazelchat.TagKeyDescription: In Hazelchat, open Website › Install on your website and copy the key. You can also paste the whole installation code.
Hazelchat.TagKeyInvalid: That is not a Hazelchat widget key. Copy it again from Website › Install on your website in Hazelchat.
Hazelchat.TagConsentDescription: Only tick this if your cookie banner tells Hazelchat about consent itself. Most supported banners work without it.
Hazelchat.PageHelp: What visitors did in the Hazelchat chat on your website: chats opened, chats started and enquiries left. The chat adds these as events (category Hazelchat) when Matomo tracks the visit. No chat text or personal details are sent to Matomo.
Hazelchat.NoEvents: No chat events in this period yet. They appear once visitors use the Hazelchat chat on this website.
Hazelchat.AddGoalHelp: See which pages and campaigns bring enquiries.
Hazelchat.GoalDescription: A visitor left an enquiry in the Hazelchat chat.
